en.title: US Lawmakers Introduce Bill to Expand Accessible Housing for Veterans and Disabled
en.summary: US Representatives Schakowsky and Duckworth have introduced legislation to increase accessible housing options for veterans, people with disabilities, and older adults. The bill proposes funding for retrofits and new construction meeting universal design standards. Other highlights include Amtrak accessibility upgrades, RAMPD's music inclusion efforts, and a University of Phoenix survey on AI's accessibility potential.

zh-TW.title: 美國國會議員提出法案 擴大退伍軍人及殘障者無障礙住房
zh-TW.summary: 美國眾議員舒克奧斯基與達克沃斯提出法案，旨在增加為退伍軍人、殘障人士與老年美國人提供的無障礙住房選項。法案將提供資金用於改建及新建符合普遍設計標準的住房。其他重點包括Amtrak無障礙升級、RAMPD推進音樂界代表性以及鳳凰城大學調查顯示AI提升工作與學習無障礙的潛力。
